message.content: {"caption":"Annotated example of a shopping-search failure and the strategies proposed to prevent it.","description":"A composite figure pairs a shopping website search-results screenshot with explanatory text. The query asks for Sony Bluetooth headphone model names and their price range. The results page is marked as containing too many items to browse and some irrelevant products. The text diagnoses the agent as spending too many steps on “page next” without answering the request, and lists strategies: optimize the search query, adjust the number of items shown per page, and use filters.","figure_type":"screenshot","chart_values":[]}
